name: @w6w-apps/oncehub
description: Manage OnceHub bookings, booking calendars, contacts, users, teams and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
OnceHub puts scheduling operations into a workflow — list, fetch, cancel, reassign and mark bookings as no-shows; read a booking calendar's own available time slots and generate a one-time scheduling link for it; manage contacts, users and teams; and create, list and remove webhook subscriptions for downstream automation. Users can be created, updated and deleted, and each one's scheduling availability read and updated directly.

The API returns every error, regardless of HTTP status, in one consistent shape naming the failure type, and the app surfaces the vendor's own message rather than collapsing distinct problems into one generic verdict — a bad key and a plan that lacks API access both come back as related but different errors. A deleted booking calendar or contact does not 404; it answers with a normal success status carrying a "deleted" flag, which the app treats as gone rather than as a live record with no data.

Authentication is a single account-wide API key, sent in a bare custom header rather than as a bearer token — OnceHub has no OAuth path for third-party integrations, and up to 25 keys can be active on an account at once with no per-key scoping.
